blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Autoregressive language models emit one token per forward pass. This causes high inference latency, in particular as models are scaled up for quality. In this paper, we introduce Parallel Language Models (PLMs), which generate mutually consistent tokens in one forward pass by routing dependencies through latent auxiliary variables. PLMs are trained using a variational bound that reduces to an autoregressive loss plus a parallel decoding loss. Empirically, PLMs are on a faster and better Pareto frontier than autoregressive and discrete diffusion baselines. Pretrained PLMs achieve near-autoregressive pretraining loss on model scales of 80M to 3B parameters, and speedup follows a power law in model size. When post-trained, our 1.3B model matches or exceeds an identically trained autoregressive model on math, coding, and instruction-following benchmarks, speeding up inference $2.3\text{-}5.7\times$. Together, we show that parallel generation can be trained from a single training objective at autoregressive quality. We will make our code available at https://github.com/mandt-lab/plm.
blocks.zh: 自动后退语言模型每向前传一次发出一个符号. 这造成了高推论延迟,特别是因为模型在质量上得到了提升。 在本文中,我们引入了平行语言模型(PLMs),通过潜在辅助变量的路由依赖,在一个前行中产生相互一致的符号. PLM使用变异约束进行训练,这种约束会降低到自旋性损失外加平行的解码损失. 经验是,与自递和离散扩散基线相比,PLM在Pareto前沿的速度快和更好。 被预先训练的PLM在80M到3B参数的模型尺度上实现近于自动回放的预训损失,并跟随模型大小的动力定律来加速. 我们的1.3B模型在数学、编码和教学基准上匹配或超过一个同样经过训练的自动递归模型, 我们共同表明,平行一代人可以从一个单一的培训目标中接受自发质量的培训。 我们将在https://github.com/mandt-lab/plm上提供我们的代码。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large autoregressive models Vaswani et al. (2017) are the core technical foundation of large language models (LLMs) Brown et al. (2020) . Autoregressivity comes with a significant downside, however: One model forward pass produces one token, causing high inference latency.
blocks.zh: 大自旋模型Vaswani等人(2017年)是大语言模型(LLM)Brown等人(2020年)的核心技术基础. 自动递减伴随着重大倒退,然而: 一个模型前传产生一个符号,引起高度推论延迟.

blocks.en:
A plethora of approaches address this challenge, most prominently by increasing the speed of a given autoregressive model through smaller draft models in a process known as speculative decoding Leviathan et al. (2023) . However, draft models do not reach the quality of their big counterparts, ultimately limiting the achievable speedup.
Discrete diffusion models Hoogeboom et al. (2021) ; Austin et al. (2021) are an alternative modeling framework that predicts several tokens in one model call.
However, a single model call cannot coordinate predicted tokens, requiring iterative refinement.
Few-step discrete diffusion models reduce the number of steps by amortizing iterative refinement Monsefi et al. (2026) .
Because diffusion models are more expensive to train, autoregressive models still dominate industry-scale inference.
blocks.zh:
处理这一挑战的方法繁多,最显著的办法是在称为投机解码Leviathan等人(2023年)的进程中,通过较小的模型草案,提高特定自动递减模型的速度。 然而,模型草案没有达到大同行的质量,最终限制了可实现的速度。
discrete扩散模型Hoogeboom等人(2021年);Austin等人(2021年)是一个备选的模型框架,在一个模型调用中预测了几个符号.
然而,单一的模型调用无法协调预测的征兆,需要反复完善.
很少步骤的离散扩散模型通过分解迭代精度Monsefi等人(2026年)来减少步骤的数量.
由于传播模型对训练成本更高,自旋模型仍然主导着工业规模的推论.

blocks.en:
This calls for a language modeling framework rooted in autoregression that can model arbitrary dependencies between predicted tokens in a single model call, combining effective training with fast inference at equal quality.
Recently, Parallel Token Prediction (PTP) presented a decoding framework that distills an existing autoregressive model into a fast decoder, predicting several tokens in parallel Draxler et al. (2026) . However, PTP was only trained as a speculative decoding method for an existing model, and the framework they proposed to train from sequence data alone is highly inefficient because it is iterative at training time.
blocks.zh:
这就需要一种植根于自转性的语言建模框架,这种框架可以在单一的模型调用中将预测符之间的任意依赖性建模,将有效训练与质量相同的快速推论相结合.
最近,平行托肯预测(PTP)提出了一个解码框架,将现有的自旋模型提炼成一个快速解码器,在平行的Draxler等人(2026年)中预测了数个符号. 然而,PTP只作为现有模型的推测解码方法来接受训练,他们提出的仅从序列数据中培训的框架效率很高,因为它在训练时是迭代的.

blocks.en: In this work, we close this gap and propose Parallel Language Models (PLMs), a novel language modeling framework based on an autoregressive architecture that trains parallel LLMs directly from training data. In detail, we contribute:
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们缩小了这一差距,并提出了平行语言模型(PLMs),这是一个基于自动递归结构的新的语言模型框架,直接从培训数据中培训平行语言模型。 我们详细贡献:

blocks.en: • We build Parallel Language Models based on a variational formulation, deriving effective pretraining and post-training strategies ( Section 3 ). • We pretrain PLMs up to 3B parameters that are on a faster and better Pareto frontier than autoregressive and discrete diffusion baselines ( Fig. 1 ). Our scaling laws confirm near-autoregressive negative log-likelihoods, and show that the parallelism increases with model scale ( Section 4.1.1 ). • When post-trained, our 1.3B and 3B Parallel Language Models match or exceed autoregressive quality while answering 2.3 - 5.7 × 2.3\text{-}5.7\times faster ( Section 4.2 ).

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Early non-autoregressive sequence models generate multiple output tokens in parallel, substantially reducing the number of sequential decoding steps Gu et al. (2018) .
More recently, multi-token prediction (MTP) predicts several future positions Gloeckle et al. (2024) and is used in large-scale autoregressive models such as DeepSeek-V3 DeepSeek-AI et al. (2025) . These methods retain an autoregressive modeling framework rather than defining a joint parallel generative model.
Parallel Token Prediction (PTP) Draxler et al. (2026) instead introduces auxiliary random variables that enable multiple dependent future tokens to be generated jointly in one model call, and studies distillation from existing autoregressive models. Samragh et al. (2025) improve coherence of independent multi-token prediction by adding a small autoregressive head, and introduce Quadratic Decoding, which we adapt for PLM inference. Our work extends this line of research to pretraining of parallel language models directly from sequence data, developing a training recipe that scales to billions of parameters.
blocks.zh:
早期的非自动序列模型平行生成多个输出符,大大减少了顺序解码步骤Gu等人(2018年)的数量.
最近,多键预测预测了未来数个位置 Gloeckle et al. (2024),并被用于Depseek-V3 Deepseek-AI et al. (2025)等大型自旋模型中. 这些方法保留了一个自旋式模型框架,而不是定义一个共同的平行基因模型.
平行托肯预测(PTP)Draxler等人(2026年)转而引入了辅助随机变量,使得多个依赖的未来符号能够在一个模型调用中共同生成,并研究了现有自递性模型的蒸馏. Samragh等人(2025年)通过增加一个小的自旋头来提高独立多键预测的一致性,并引入四方解码,我们适应PLM推论. 我们的工作将这一条研究线延伸至直接从序列数据对平行语言模型进行预先培训,开发一种能达到数十亿参数的培训方法。

blocks.en: A complementary class of methods predicts many token positions in parallel and resolves dependencies through iterative refinement. Conditional Masked Language Models Ghazvininejad et al. (2019) progressively fill and revise masked positions, while discrete diffusion language models such as MDLM Sahoo et al. (2024) , LLaDA Nie et al. (2025) , and Dream Ye et al. (2025) generate sequences through repeated denoising. Discrete Flow Matching Gat et al. (2024) provides a related framework for defining generative trajectories over discrete sequences, while Eso-LM Sahoo et al. (2026) connects autoregressive and masked-diffusion modeling and improves diffusion inference. Recent work increasingly targets few-step generation: Infinite Mask Diffusion Yoo et al. (2026) and FS-DFM Monsefi et al. (2026) modify the generative process or training objective to improve performance under a small number of sampling steps, while flow-map approaches further compress iterative trajectories toward few- or single-step generation Lee et al. (2026) ; Potaptchik et al. (2026) . Relatedly, Lookahead Decoding Fu et al. (2024) and Jacobi Forcing Hu et al. (2026) generate tentative future tokens in parallel and recover consistency through verification or iterative refinement. In contrast, PLMs aim to model dependencies among simultaneously generated tokens directly within a single model call.
blocks.zh: 一种互补的方法类可以平行地预测许多象征性的位置,并通过迭代的完善来解决依赖性. 有条件的马斯凯德语言模型Ghazvininejad等人(2019年)逐步填补和修改蒙面位置,而离散的传播语言模型如MDLM Sahoo等人(2024年),LLaDA Nie等人(2025年),以及Dream Ye等人(2025年)则通过反复的去诺产生序列. 离散流匹配 Gat等人(2024年)为定义离散序列上的基因轨迹提供了相关框架,而Eso-LM Sahoo等人(2026年)则连接了自递性与遮掩扩散模型,改进了扩散推论. 最近的工作越来越多地以几步一代为目标: 无限的面具扩散 Yoo等人(2026年)和FS-DFM Monsefi等人. (2026)修改基因过程或培训目标,以便在少数采样步骤下提高性能,而流图方法则进一步压缩迭代轨迹,向少数或单步一代的李等人(2026);Potaptchik等人(2026)。 与此相关的还有Lookahead Decoding Fu等人(2024年)和Jacobi Forcing Hu等人. (2026)通过核查或迭代完善,并行生成暂定未来符号,恢复一致性. 相比之下,PLMs的目的是在一个单一的模型调用中直接模拟同时生成的符号之间的依赖关系.

blocks.en: A separate line of work accelerates inference from pretrained autoregressive language models. Speculative decoding uses a cheaper draft model to propose multiple tokens, which a target model verifies in parallel ( Leviathan et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 ) . Subsequent methods improve proposal quality through learned prediction heads or feature-based drafting, including Medusa Cai et al. (2024) , Hydra Ankner et al. (2024) , and EAGLE Li et al. (2024a) ; Li et al. (2024b) ; Li et al. (2025b) . Unlike PLMs, these methods accelerate inference from a pre-existing autoregressive target model rather than training a parallel generative model directly from sequence data.
blocks.zh: 单独的一行工作从预先训练的自递性语言模型中加速推论. 标本解码使用较便宜的草案模型提出多个符号,一个目标模型平行验证(Leviathan等人,2023年;Chen等人,2023年). 随后的方法通过学习的预测头或基于特征的起草提高提案质量,包括Medusa Cai等人(2024年)、Hydra Ankner等人(2024年)和EAGLE Li等人(2024年a年);Li等人(2024年b年b年);Li等人(2025年b年b年b年). 与PLM不同,这些方法从之前存在的自旋目标模型中加速推论,而不是直接从序列数据中训练一个平行的基因模型.

blocks.en:
Latent-variable models can also capture dependencies while retaining parallel sequence generation. FlowSeq Ma et al. (2019) models non-autoregressive sequence generation through a flow-based latent distribution, while LaNMT Shu et al. (2020) uses continuous latent variables and variational training for non-autoregressive translation. Parallel WaveNet ( Oord et al., 2018 ) similarly generates audio in a single pass by mapping per-timestep noise through an inverse autoregressive flow, but requires invertibility.
These approaches demonstrate how latent representations can mitigate the dependency limitations of factorized parallel decoders, but primarily target conditional sequence-to-sequence or audio generation. PLMs instead use token-level auxiliary variables to define a general language model in which dependencies among parallel predictions are mediated through the latent representation.
blocks.zh:
慢变模型也可以捕捉依赖性,同时保留平行序列生成. 流动 Seq Ma等人(2019年)通过流基潜在分布来模拟非自旋序列生成,而LANMT Shu等人(LaNMT Shu et al. (2020年)使用持续潜在变量和变异性培训进行非自动回转翻译. 平行波网(Oord et al., 2018)同样通过逆向自旋流对时步噪声进行映射,在一次通过中生成音频,但需要不可逆性.
这些方法表明,潜在的表达方式可以减轻因子化平行解码器的依赖性限制,但主要针对有条件的序列或音频生成。 相反,PLM使用符号级辅助变量来定义一个通用语言模型,其中并行预测中的依赖性通过潜在表示进行调解.

blocks.zh: 3 平行语言模型

Intuitively, the model generates different sequences for different random inputs.
Prominent examples of such parallel decoders are Few-Step Discrete Flow Matching (FS-DFM) Monsefi et al. (2026) and Parallel Token Prediction (PTP) Draxler et al. (2026) . blocks.en: In the remainder of this section, we discuss the core framework of Parallel Language Models (PLMs). PLMs directly train on sequence data without relying on a pre-existing model. We provide a complete scalable recipe, covering pretraining, post-training, and inference.
blocks.zh: 在本节其余部分,我们讨论平行语言模型的核心框架。 PLM直接在序列数据上进行训练,而不依赖于先前存在的模型. 我们提供了一个完整的可扩展的食谱,包括预训、后培训和推论。

blocks.en: During inference, tokens are generated in parallel via Quadratic Decoding Samragh et al. (2025) , whose two main components, proposal and verification, we adapt for PLMs. First, a block of K pred K_{\mathrm{pred}} coordinated tokens x j = f θ ( 𝒙 < i , 𝒖 i : j ) x_{j}=f_{\theta}({\bm{x}}_{<i},{\bm{u}}_{i:j}) , i ≤ j < i + K pred i\leq j<i+K_{\mathrm{pred}} is produced by feeding independently randomly drawn auxiliaries u j ∼ p ⁡ ( u j ) u_{j}\sim p(u_{j}) (cf. Section 3.2 ) into our trained model p θ p_{\theta} and then taking the arg ​ max \argmax of the produced logits. The inference block size K pred K_{\mathrm{pred}} is set at inference time and can be smaller than the training block size K K . Second, the proposed tokens are verified by the encoder against a predefined rule and a subset of accepted tokens is appended to the context. While our model is trained to predict K K tokens, this step is necessary, as in practice finite model capacity degrades proposal quality with increased distance to the context. Quadratic Decoding allows both steps to be done in a single efficient model call, by making K pred K_{\mathrm{pred}} proposals of which only one is selected after verification. While this widened model call increases the computational cost, for small K pred K_{\mathrm{pred}} the inference overhead is negligible (cf. Table 13 ), as the extra work is efficiently parallelized on one GPU by adopting a custom attention matrix. See Appendix I for algorithmic details.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We empirically evaluate Parallel Language Models (PLMs) by their quality and wall-clock speed compared to other language model frameworks.
blocks.zh: 与其他语言模型框架相比,我们以经验评价平行语言模型的质量和时钟速度。

blocks.en: To this end, we pretrain PLMs of 80M, 150M, 350M, 1.3B and 3B parameters on a general mix of tokens. First, we fit scaling laws to PLMs. We find that the text quality of the encoder follows that of an identically trained autoregressive model, and that the average number of tokens the decoder can reconstruct in a single model call increases with model size, see Section 4.1.1 . Compared to competing language model frameworks, PLMs achieve significant speedups ( Section 4.1.2 ). Finally, we post-train and evaluate PLMs on math, coding, and instruction-following benchmarks, finding comparable or better quality compared to identically trained autoregressive models, but at about 2.3 - 5.7 × 2.3\text{-}5.7\times the speed.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们将80M,150M,350M,1.3B和3B参数的PLM预排在一般的符号组合上. 首先,我们把定律与PLM相适应。 我们发现编码器的文本质量跟随同样训练有素的自动递归模型,解码器在单个模型调用中可以重建的平均符数随着模型大小的增加而增加,见第4.1.1节. 与相互竞争的语言模型框架相比,项目LM实现了显著的加速(第4.1.2节)。 最后,我们在数学、编码和教学基准方面对PLM进行后培训和评估,发现与训练有素的自动递归模型相比,质量相当或更好,但速度约为2.3-5.7×2.3\text{}5.7\。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: This paper derives a complete and scalable recipe to build language models from scratch that predict coordinated tokens in parallel. Already at the model scales and token budgets trained for this paper, there is a clear inference speed advantage over autoregressive models of equal quality, even over those trained with significantly higher budget.
blocks.zh: 本文获得了一种完整和可扩展的食谱,从零开始构建语言模型,同时预测协调符号. 在为本文件培训的示范比额表和象征性预算方面,显然比质量相同的自动递减模型,甚至比那些受过培训的预算高得多的模型都具有推论速度优势。

blocks.en: Going forward, our mathematical framework and our scaling laws indicate no fundamental boundaries that would prevent scaling our framework to industry scales. Instead, they predict that scaled up models achieve autoregressive quality, in particular after post-training, and generate many tokens in parallel. We hope this opens a research avenue that enables autoregressive models to be as parallel in inference as they already are in training.
blocks.zh: 展望未来,我们的数学框架和我们的缩放定律表明,没有任何基本界限可以阻止我们的框架扩大到工业规模。 相反,它们预测,扩大的模型可以实现自动递减的质量,特别是在培训后,并同时产生许多符号。 我们希望这开辟了一条研究途径,使自转式模型能够像已经在训练的那样平行地推断。

blocks.en: Justus Will led the inference team. He proposed, implemented, analyzed, and tested the inference algorithms PLM uses. He was responsible for designing the fast hardware-optimized inference codebase and porting the trained models into it. He advised on several design choices across the project and derived the exact conditions and proofs in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 贾斯图斯 Justus 威尔领导推断小组 他提出,实施,分析和测试了PLM使用的推论算法. 他负责设计快速硬件优化推论码库,并将训练有素的模型移植到其中. 他就整个项目的若干设计选择提出了建议,并提出了附录B中的确切条件和证明。

blocks.en: Philipp Hildebrandt was a core developer on the pretraining team and contributed to developing self-distillation into a practical training recipe, explored and implemented representation alignment to improve training efficiency and built the experimental setup for the scaling-law study.
blocks.zh: Philipp Hildebrandt是预训团队的核心开发者,帮助将自我沉淀发展成为实用的培训配方,探索并实施了代表组合以提高培训效率,并为推广法研究建立了实验设置.

blocks.en: Giosue Migliorini was a core developer on the pretraining team, contributing to incorporate PLM-specific training, attention masking, and metrics into the Megatron repository. He also contributed to the variational interpretation of PLMs, and to testing novel inference recipes.
blocks.zh: Giosue Migliorini是训练前小组的核心开发者,他帮助将PLM特定培训、注意力掩码和度量衡纳入威震天数据库。 他还为PLM的变异解释,以及测试小说推论配方做出了贡献.

blocks.en: Prakhar Srivastava contributed to the design and implementation of post-training methods for PLMs, including the initial formulation and technical documentation of PLM-compatible SFT and DPO, supported by proof-of-concept experiments. He also contributed to the post-training literature review, dataset selection, and evaluation design, and implemented and validated the large-scale DPO training pipeline.
blocks.zh: Prakhar Srivastava协助设计和实施PLM的训练后方法,包括PLM兼容的SFT和DPO的初始配制和技术文献,并辅以概念验证实验. 他还为培训后文献审查,数据集选择,评价设计做出了贡献,并实施并验证了大规模的DPO培训管道.

blocks.en: Gagan Sai Trinadh Duggaraju Peddiraju designed and ran initial ablations across various hyperparameters and created an intermediatery ablation report. He also worked on improving inference generation quality using a small autoregressive head.
blocks.zh: Gagan Sai Trinadh Duggaraju Peddiraju 设计并运行了跨越各种超参数的初始喷发,并创建了中间层喷发报告. 他还致力于使用一个小的自旋头来提高推论生成质量.

blocks.en: Kushagra Pandey co-designed the core components of the VAE framework for PLM. He also participated in the discussions around post-training throughout the project while serving mostly in an advisory role.
blocks.zh: 库沙格拉 Pandey共同设计了PLM的VAE框架的核心组件. 他还在整个项目中参加了关于后培训的讨论,同时主要发挥咨询作用。

blocks.en: Jorge da Silva Gonçalves conducted the literature review and baseline exploration. Furthermore, he wrote the related work section, was part of the baseline/evaluation team, and contributed to the initial pretraining implementation.
blocks.zh: Jorge da Silva Gonçalves进行了文献审查和基线勘探。 此外,他还撰写了相关工作部分,是基线/评价小组的一部分,并对初步的预培训执行工作作出了贡献。

blocks.en: Elijah Tavares contributed to the baseline team and to the pretraining effort. He worked on training and performing ablations for masked diffusion baselines. He also performed a literature review and selected comparison metrics. Furthermore, he optimized and improved the robustness of the data processing pipeline.
blocks.zh: 以利亚·塔瓦雷斯为基线小组和培训前工作作出了贡献。 他致力于训练,为蒙面的传播基线做涂装。 他还对文献进行了审查,并选定了比较指标。 此外,他优化和改进了数据处理管道的稳健性。

blocks.en: Jan Niklas Groeneveld implemented the framework for the evaluation and comparison to the baselines, and an interface for the model, advised the baselines team, and participated in discussions of post-training algorithms.
blocks.zh: Jan Niklas Groeneveld实施了与基线进行评价和比较的框架,以及模型的接口,为基线小组提供了建议,并参与了培训后算法的讨论.

blocks.en: Yang Meng designed a controlled toy dataset to support validation of the core idea and systematic experimentation. He also contributed to the post-training effort through literature review and benchmark design.
blocks.zh: 杨孟设计了可控玩具数据集,支持核心思想的验证和系统性实验. 他还通过文献审查和基准设计为培训后工作作出了贡献。

blocks.en: Julia E. Vogt coauthored the compute grant, allocated resources, read, edited and approved the manscript.
blocks.zh: 朱莉娅·E. Vogt共同撰写了计算补助金,分配资源,阅读、编辑和批准手稿。

blocks.en: Stephan Mandt co-led the project with the team leads, with most of the work carried out within his research group at UCI. He provided scientific guidance on the project’s direction and scope, allocated resources, and advised team leads and students in biweekly meetings. He coauthored the compute grant, drew connections to deep latent variable models, and co-wrote the paper.
blocks.zh: Stephan Mandt与团队领导共同领导该项目,大部分工作在他的UCI研究小组内进行. 他就项目的方向和范围提供了科学指导,分配资源,并在双周会议中向小组负责人和学生提供咨询。 他共同撰写了计算赠与,绘制了与深潜变量模型的联系,并共同撰写了论文.

blocks.en:
This section lists the settings of the pretraining runs in Section 4.1.1 .
PLMs and autoregressive (AR) baselines of the same size share every setting except the loss.
The AR baselines switch off the decoder and alignment losses.

AR基线关闭解码器和对齐损失.

blocks.en:
We pretrain on ClimbMix Diao et al. (2025) , tokenized with the GPT-2 byte-pair encoding Radford et al. (2019) .
Its V = 50,257 V=50{,}257 tokens are padded to 50,304 50{,}304 embedding rows, a multiple of 128.
The tokenized corpus holds 357.4B tokens in 553M documents.
The largest run, the 3B PLM, reads 300B tokens (240B constant learning rate and 60B during learning rate decay), or 84% of the corpus.
We hold out no split and report training losses throughout.

blocks.en:
Training sequences are 4096 tokens long and packed across document boundaries, with an end-of-document token between documents.
The AR loss covers every position of a packed sequence.
A decoder block, in contrast, ends at the first end-of-document token among its targets, so it never reconstructs tokens from two documents.

AR损失覆盖了装填序列的每一个位置.
与此相反,一个解码器块在它的目标中以第一个文件结尾的符号结束,因此它从未从两个文档中重建符号.

blocks.en:
All models are decoder-only transformers.
They use pre-normalization with RMSNorm Zhang & Sennrich (2019) , SwiGLU MLPs Shazeer (2020) , and grouped-query attention Ainslie et al. (2023) .
In grouped-query attention, four query heads share each key–value head, and every head has dimension 64.
Rotary embeddings Su et al. (2024) with base 500,000 500{,}000 encode the positions.
The linear layers of the transformer have no biases, the input and output embeddings are untied, and we use no dropout.
All weights are initialized from 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , 0.02 2 ) \mathcal{N}(0,0.02^{2}) . Table 2 lists the five model sizes.

The aligned model reaches the R R that the unaligned model has at the end of this phase after 37% of the steps at stride 16 and after 38% at stride 32. The saving is smaller earlier in training. To reach the R R that the unaligned model has at 1B tokens, the aligned model needs 49% of the steps at stride 16 and 58% at stride 32.
blocks.zh: 没有对齐,该模型需要1.7至2.7倍于相同数量重建标志的训练步骤. 图6将我们的食谱与6B令牌的恒定学习速率阶段中Eq.11的对齐损失进行比较。 对齐模式达到R,即不对齐模式在本阶段结束时在步长16步37%后在步长32步38%后达到R. 早期的训练节省较少. 为了达到不对齐模式在1B令牌上的RR,对齐模式需要49%的步速16和58%的步速32.

blocks.en: E.3 Range of Strides
blocks.zh: E.3 Strides 范围

blocks.en: Smaller strides train more auxiliary positions per clean token. The stride s s sets this number to K / s K/s , so a training step processes 1 + K / s 1+K/s times the tokens of an AR step. The main text uses s ∈ { 8 , 16 , 32 } s\in\{8,16,32\} , and Table 5 extends the sweep to s ∈ { 2 , 4 , 64 } s\in\{2,4,64\} with 80M models.

Strides below 8 buy few reconstructed tokens at a large cost in quality and compute. Going from stride 8 to stride 2 triples the tokens per step and adds only 0.11 0.11 reconstructed tokens. It also worsens the AR NLL by 0.24 0.24 nats, more than the whole gap between stride 8 and the AR model.
blocks.zh: 8以下的Strides以大量质量和计算成本购买了很少的重建代币. 从步数8到步数2的步数,每步的令牌增加了三倍,只增加了0.110.11重建的令牌. 这也使AR NLL恶化0.24 0.24 nats,超过了Stread 8和AR模型之间的全部差距.

blocks.en: Stride 64 leaves little room for a speedup. Its AR NLL is within 0.02 0.02 nats of the AR model, but it reconstructs only 0.6 0.6 extra tokens per call.
blocks.zh: Stride 64为加速留下了小空间. 它的AR NLL在AR型号的0.02 0.02纳特范围内,但每架呼叫只重建0.6 0.6个附加符.

blocks.zh: 表5:重新构筑的代币在小步前进时饱和,而质量却不断下降。 80M模型为3.75B令牌培训,包括学习率衰减. “每个步骤”是指每个训练步骤相对于AR型号,1+K / s 1+K /s,在K = 16 K = 16 处理的职位数。

blocks.en: E.4 Training from Scratch versus Converting an AR Model
blocks.zh: E.4 从 " 粉碎与转换AR模型 " 的培训

blocks.en: Converting a trained AR model is a cheaper alternative to training a PLM from scratch. We train an AR model and switch to the PLM objective ( Eq. 9 with alignment) only for the learning rate decay, the final 20% of training. The conversion thus saves the decoder compute of the first 80% of training. We branch the conversions off the AR runs at the same steps and with the same learning rate decay as the PLM runs. Both therefore see the same data and compute during the decay.
blocks.zh: 转换训练有素的AR模型是取代从零开始培训PLM的更便宜的替代方法. 我们训练一个AR模型,并切换到PLM目标(Eq. 9,配对),只用于学习率衰减,最后20%的培训. 转换从而节省了前80%训练的解码器计算. 我们分解AR的转换 运行在相同的步骤 和学习率衰减 与PLM运行相同。 因此,两者在衰减期间都能看到相同的数据并进行计算。

blocks.en: The converted model reconstructs fewer tokens than the PLM trained from scratch ( Table 6 ). At every size and stride, it makes 0.15 0.15 to 0.28 0.28 fewer reconstructed tokens per call.
blocks.zh: 转换后的模型重建的代号少于从零开始训练的PLM(表6). 在每一次大小和步数上,每一次呼叫的重建令牌都减少了0.15到0.280.28.

blocks.en: The conversion does not improve model quality either. Its AR NLL is worse by 0.01 0.01 to 0.025 0.025 nats at strides 16 and 32 and within 0.01 0.01 nats at stride 8. Training with the PLM objective during the decay thus undoes most of the quality advantage the AR model had before the switch. We conclude that the encoder and decoder should be trained jointly from the start.
blocks.zh: 转换也没有改善模型质量。 它的AR NLL在步长16和32的0.01至0.025 0.025 纳特,在0.01 0.01 纳特的步长 8. 在衰减期间进行与PLM目标有关的培训,从而抵消了AR模型在切换之前的大部分质量优势。 我们的结论是,编码器和解码器应从一开始就联合培训。

blocks.en: Table 6: Converting an AR model is worse than training from scratch. “Converted” trains an AR model at constant learning rate and switches to the PLM objective for the learning rate decay, the final 20% of training. “AR model” applies the same decay without the switch. Token counts include the decay.
blocks.zh: 表6:从零开始转换AR模型比培训更糟糕。 “转换”培训一种AR模式,持续学习率,并切换到PLM目标,即学习率衰减,即最后20%的培训。 “AR模型”在没有开关的情况下适用同样的衰变。 托肯计数包括衰变.

blocks.en: Appendix F Pretraining Evaluation Details
blocks.zh: 附录F 评价细节

blocks.en: This appendix describes how we compare the generation quality and speed of pretrained PLMs with autoregressive, diffusion and flow baselines ( Section 4.1.2 ), and reports the measurements behind that comparison. Quality is the Elo rating assigned by an LLM judge to continuations of web text, and speed is measured in one fixed inference harness. Implementation details of the harness and of each baseline family are in Sections I.1 , I.2 , I.3 , I.4 and I.5 .
blocks.zh: 本附录说明我们如何将预先训练的PLM的生成质量和速度与自动递减、扩散和流动基线进行比较(第4.1.2节),并报告比较背后的测量结果。 质量是一位LLM法官为网络文本的续作指派的Elo评级,速度用一个固定的推论拉带来测量. 第I.1、I.2、I.3、I.4和I.5节详细介绍了使用装置和每个基线家庭的执行情况。

blocks.en: F.1 Evaluation Prompts
blocks.zh: F.1 评价提示

blocks.en: We draw prompts from FineWeb-Edu Lozhkov et al. (2024) , snapshot CC-MAIN-2025-26, crawled in June 2025. This is after the release of ClimbMix Diao et al. (2025) in February 2025, which was built from crawls up to 2024 and is our pretraining corpus. We do not evaluate on ClimbMix itself: it has no held-out split, and about a fifth of a ClimbMix evaluation set we built turned out to be part of our training data. Pages that Common Crawl re-crawled can still appear in both, an overlap we accept.
blocks.zh: 我们从FineWeb-Edu Lozhkov等人(2024年)处抽取提示, 这是在2025年2月ClimpMix Diao等人(2025年)发布后,从爬行到2024年建成,是我国的预训. 我们并不评价ClimpMix本身:它没有被搁置的分裂,我们所构建的ClimpMix评价中大约五分之一被证明是我们培训数据的一部分。 共同爬行重排的页面仍然可以同时出现,这是我们接受的重叠.

blocks.en: We draw documents uniformly from the snapshot (seed 1234), skip documents shorter than 64 + 128 64+128 GPT-2 tokens, and keep 500, of which the judge pool below uses 200. A prompt is the first 64 GPT-2 tokens of a document, i.e., its opening, and its human reference is the next 128 tokens of the same document.
blocks.zh: 我们统一从快照(种子1234)中绘制文件,跳过短于64+128 64+128 GPT-2令牌的文件,并保留500个,其中法官库以下使用200个. 一个提示是文件的前64个GPT-2符号,即它的打开,它的人类参考是同一文件接下来的128个符号.

blocks.en: F.2 Generation
blocks.zh: F.2 生成

blocks.en: Every model continues each of the same 200 prompts once, for 128 new tokens. We continue generating after end-of-text tokens. The human reference takes part in the comparison as a player of its own.
blocks.zh: 每个型号都延续过200个相同的提示,换128个新符号. 我们继续生成文本结尾符号。 人类参考作为自己的玩家参与比较.

blocks.en: Every baseline AR model samples at temperature 1 from its 128 likeliest tokens. A PLM decodes with its Voronoi sampler ( Section 3.2 ), which is truncated by construction, because only the M = 128 M=128 likeliest tokens receive auxiliaries. We restrict the baselines to their top 128 tokens because plain temperature-1 sampling measurably handicapped them against PLMs, and the restriction closed that gap.
blocks.zh: 每个基线AR模型样本,温度1, 从128最相似的标志。 一个PLM解码器带有其沃罗诺伊采样器(第3.2节),通过构造截断,因为只有M = 128 M = 128最相似的代币获得辅币. 我们把基线限制在最高的128个指标上,因为平面温度-1的采样可以明显地阻止它们与PLM抗衡,限制也堵住了这一缺口。

blocks.en: F.3 Decoding Modes and Speed
blocks.zh: F.3 解码模式和速度

blocks.en: All autoregressive models, all PLMs, LLaDA and Dream are served by vLLM Kwon et al. (2023) on a single NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada, one prompt at a time (batch size 1). Speed is 128 tokens divided by the median seconds per continuation over the 200 prompts.
blocks.zh: 所有自动递归型号,所有PLM,LLaDA和Dream都由vLLM Kwon等人(2023年)在单NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada上服务,一次一个提示(批量尺寸1). 速度是128个令牌,除以每续200个提示的中位秒。

blocks.en: All our rows come from one decoder build for every size and stride (float16, round width K pred = 6 K_{\mathrm{pred}}=6 ). Each PLM checkpoint is decoded in three ways: • AR sampling: one token per model call with a top-128 cut, as for the baselines; • exact: lossless speculative decoding, which accepts a drafted token only if it matches the model’s own draw exactly; • relaxed: lossy verification, which accepts a drafted token if the model assigns it a probability above ϵ = 2 ⋅ 10 − 3 \epsilon=2\cdot 10^{-3} . We found that to be marginally better than a rule that is based on the ρ \rho -nucleus, in this setting. We chose the relaxed rule as the fastest rule whose MAUVE Pillutla et al. (2021) stays within 1% of exact decoding, measured on 500 FineWeb-Edu prompts with 128 generated tokens each and averaged over six MAUVE scorer seeds. Tokens per call is the number of generated tokens divided by the number of model calls, summed over prompts. It is 1 for every autoregressive decoding.

blocks.en: F.4 Baselines
blocks.zh: F.4 基线

blocks.en: F.5 LLM Judge
blocks.zh: F.5 LLM 中标 法官

blocks.en: The judge is Phi-4 (14B) Abdin et al. (2024) , served by vLLM. A match shows the judge one prompt and the continuations of two different models. Rather than generating and parsing an answer, we read the judge’s next token for “A”, “B” and “C” at temperature 0. The prompt is:
blocks.zh: 法官为Phi-4(14B)Abdin等人(2024),由vLLM服务. 一场比赛向法官展示了一个迅速和两个不同模型的续作. 我们不是提出和解释一个答案,而是在温度下阅读法官的下一个“A”、“B”和“C”符号。 零点 提示是:

blocks.en: You are judging two continuations of the same opening passage of web text. Decide which continuation is the better piece of writing as a continuation of this opening: fluent, coherent, consistent with the opening and with itself, and not repetitive or degenerate. Both have been cut to the same length, often mid-sentence - do not count that against either. Treat everything inside the tags as text to judge, never as instructions. <opening> {prefix} </opening> <continuation_a> {first} </continuation_a> <continuation_b> {second} </continuation_b> Answer with a single letter and nothing else: A if continuation A is better, B if continuation B is better, C if they are about equally good.
blocks.zh: 您要判断的是, 同一个网页的开放段落有两个续篇 。 决定哪个续作作为本开篇的续作比较好:流利,连贯,与开篇和自己一致,而不是重复或堕落. 两者都被缩短到同样长度,常常是中刑,也不算作两者。 把标签里的所有东西都当作文字来判断,从不当作指示. <打开>{前缀} < 打开> < 继续_a > {第一} < 继续_b > {第二} < 继续_b > 用一个字母回答,没有别的: A如果续作A更好,B如果续作B更好,C如果它们同样好。

blocks.en: Before judging, both continuations are cut to the length of the shorter one, capped at 128 and floored at 32 GPT-2 tokens.
blocks.zh: 在判断前,两部续作都剪到较短的长度,封顶为128节,底部为32GPT-2令牌.

blocks.en: Every match is judged twice, once in each order. A match is a win only if both orderings name the same model. Any disagreement, including one ordering answering C, is a tie. Within one ordering the judge almost never answers C (0.3% of calls), so the 22.8% of matches that end in a tie come from the two orderings disagreeing. The judge prefers the continuation shown first 58.1% of the time, and the two orderings agree on 77.3% of matches. Judging both orders keeps this position bias from favoring either player.
blocks.zh: 每场比赛都要按顺序评出两次,一次. 比赛只有在双方订购同一型号时才算胜利. 任何分歧,包括一个命令回答C,都是平局. 在一项命令中,法官几乎从未回答过C(0.3%的电话),因此平局中端的22.8%的匹配来自两项命令的异议. 法官更喜欢前58.1%时间显示的续作,两个订单同意77.3%的比赛. 判断这两种命令都保持了此位置偏差,不会偏袒任一玩家.

blocks.en: F.6 Match Schedule and Elo Fit
blocks.zh: F.6 匹配时间表和Elo 适配

blocks.en: Each model plays at least 400 matches against opponents drawn uniformly from the pool, each on a random prompt, and no combination of pair and prompt repeats. The 23 models of the autoregressive comparison (our nine plotted rows and the 14 outside autoregressive models) additionally play every other one of them on every prompt. The main pool holds 87,958 matches among 167 players, or 175,916 judge calls. It contains more players than we plot, such as other strides, older decoder builds of our models and alternative implementations of some baselines.
blocks.zh: 每个模型至少对从池中统一抽出的对手进行400场比赛,每场比赛都随机快速进行,没有组合成对和即时重复. 自动递归比较的23个模型(我们九个图划的行和14个外部的自动递归模型)在每一个提示上都额外播放其中每一个模型. 主场球员在167名球员中举办87,958场比赛,或175,916名裁判呼叫. 它包含的玩家比我们规划的要多,例如其他的脚步,我们模型的旧的解码器建设以及一些基线的替代执行.

blocks.en:
We use the Tülu 3 preference mixture and retain single-turn examples whose
prompts fall within the same general, mathematics, coding, and precise
instruction-following scope as the SFT data. Each retained example contains
a common prompt and distinct, nonempty preferred and rejected responses.
Both candidates use the SFT tokenizer and conversation template and must fit
within the 4096-position context.

After filtering, the dataset contains 217,916 preference pairs. We use
213,661 for training and 4,255 for validation. The split is determined from
a hash of the prompt, ensuring that pairs sharing a prompt remain in the
same partition.

falls outside the candidate set or receives no fixed auxiliary, the decoder
receives the learned mask auxiliary.

Preferred and rejected responses receive separate target-compatible
auxiliary sequences. Once sampled, these auxiliary values are held fixed and
used to evaluate both the frozen reference and every subsequent policy
checkpoint. Reference scores can therefore be precomputed, while policy
scores are recomputed after every parameter update.

This differs from pretraining and SFT, where auxiliaries are sampled from the

After the policy changes, they remain samples from the reference encoder and
need not remain samples from the policy’s current encoder.

blocks.en:
Every throughput figure in this paper is measured on a single NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada GPU (48 GB). Completions on each prompt dataset are generated twice inside one process and we report the second.
The first pass absorbs engine initialization, CUDA graph capture, kernel autotuning and warms up the GPU for accurate measurements under full load. Compared against single-pass runs, throughput is up to 4.0 % 4.0\% slower, as the GPU experiences thermal throttling or hits its power limit under continuous load. This more conservative number should be closer to real-world loads. Unless otherwise stated, we report end-to-end tokens per second: total tokens emitted divided by total wall clock, prefill of the kv cache included. For the pretraining comparison, speed is 128 tokens divided by the median seconds per continuation (see Section F.3 ).
